title: Day jobs: house painting and railroad electrician
summary: Harry, Jim and Larry painted houses; Larry sold church goods, and Harry worked for a railroad as an electrician.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: What kind of work did your brother Jim do? He was a painter. Painter?
Did you ever have a day job? Most musicians do have to fill in something in the daytime.
Oh yeah, I've worked house painting. Yeah. My father was a contractor.
Did Larry do any outside work when he was a kid? Larry was a house painter, yeah. He was too. Of course, Larry was a salesman too. Mm-hmm. He sold church goods, and...
I worked for a railroad for quite a few years. Electrician. Yeah.
